meta.name: golden-chat-empty
meta.description: Use when testing the golden_chat_empty golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用于测试空构建的聊天功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要验证空构建的聊天功能是否正常
copy.tagline_en: Test chat functionality for empty builds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify chat functionality for empty builds

howto.what: 此技能对应一份名为 golden_chat_empty 的空 Slack 聊天记录。装上后,Claude 会把它当作可查询的团队讨论来源;由于记录为空,查询时只会报告没有任何内容。
howto.when: 当用户提到 golden_chat_empty 聊天历史中的解决方案、代码片段、决策等时触发;也用于测试该 golden build。

say.text: 这个项目的 Slack 历史里讨论过什么？
say.note: 会查该记录,但记录为空,所以回复没有内容。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 golden_chat_empty 里的代码片段
say.note: 同样会检索该记录,结果为空。

say.text: 测试一下 golden_chat_empty 这个 build

howto.what_en: This skill corresponds to an empty Slack chat export named golden_chat_empty. Once installed, Claude treats it as a queryable team discussion source; because the export contains no messages, queries only return 'no content'.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about historical content (e.g., solutions, code snippets, decisions) from the golden_chat_empty chat, or when testing this golden build.

say_en.text: What was discussed in this project's Slack history?
say_en.note: Checks the empty record and finds nothing.

say_en.text: Search for code snippets in golden_chat_empty.
say_en.note: Also searches the chat, with empty results.
Triggers the skill; same empty result.
